Resource Profile: MedicationRequest (SAN)

Official URL: https://ig.santeon.nl/sim-on-fhir/StructureDefinition/medicationRequest-san Version: 0.1.0
Draft as of 2026-11-11 Computable Name: MedicationRequestSan

Generiek Santeon FHIR R4-profiel voor medicatieafspraken.

Gebaseerd op het Santeon Informatiemodel (SIMMedicatieAfspraak).

De-identificatie wordt uitgevoerd volgens afzonderlijke transformatiespecificaties en is geen inherente eigenschap van dit profiel.

Usages:

  • This Profile is not used by any profiles in this Specification

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics

This structure refers to these other structures:

This structure defines the following Slices:

  • The element 1 is sliced based on the value of MedicationRequest.medication[x]
  • The element 1 is sliced based on the value of MedicationRequest.dosageInstruction.timing.repeat.bounds[x]
